summary: Obsidian Entertainment's choice-driven isometric RPG set after an evil empire has already won, with post-launch story and event DLC folded into the best current play route.

entries.title: Tyranny
entries.definitive_edition: Tyranny Gold Edition / Windows release with Bastard's Wound and Tales from the Tiers

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release rather than any compatibility/emulation layer unless needed for storefront support.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC output with all DLC installed.

primary.version: Tyranny Gold Edition / Windows release with Bastard's Wound and Tales from the Tiers
primary.why: Windows is the highest-fidelity/capture route, and the complete run should include the Bastard's Wound and Tales from the Tiers DLC because they add story, travel events, companion material, and expanded content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC release with Bastard's Wound and Tales from the Tiers installed; use the current Steam/GOG/Epic build and apply compatibility tweaks if needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or platform-exclusive story content is documented; completeness comes from installing the DLC.
